journal.title: NEW MESSAGE (1)
journal.text:
FROM: dana.reyes@cat-inc.com
SENT: 6:41 PM
SUBJECT: (no subject)

If you are reading this I am already downstairs.

The "retention program" is not a bonus scheme. Nobody who gets selected comes back up. I saw Martin go into the restricted elevator in March and his desk was cleared by lunch.

Pruitt keeps a B1 keycard in his desk. His office is open now — the cleaners unlock it at end of day.

Don't trust Thatch. Don't let him see you.

— D.
